output.answer_markdown: The material does not state the per-unit price Amazon pays its suppliers for Echo devices. It only says that Amazon manufactures and sells Echo devices [1].

provenance.quote: We also manufacture and sell electronic devices, including Kindle, Fire tablet, Fire TV, Echo, Ring, and other devices, and we develop and produce media content.

claims.text: Amazon manufactures and sells Echo devices.

found: Amazon manufactures and sells Echo devices.
missing: Per-unit prices Amazon pays to its suppliers for Echo devices, such as a supplier pricing disclosure or a per-unit cost figure.
refusal.reason: The passages describe Echo devices as Amazon-made products but contain no supplier pricing or per-unit cost paid to suppliers.
